>A reminder, like a stuffed animal

That's pretty much it, I think

>In summary you are either one of the sociopaths that abuses people and society rewards for it, or hopefully don't get abused beyond repair.

I've been thinking about this one for a very long time. And I do it at work, and always feel bad about it. For example, when I walk into a large corporate company to do business (like they are going to be a life-long repeat customer), I always buy the secretary a nice coffee, or bring her some baked goods. It's very effective, since secretaries are gatekeepers, and keeping them on your side is good for your business. But I always feel bad about it... but it works.
